description:
Create a new Compass session.

Returns a `session_id` that MUST be passed into every subsequent
Compass tool call. Server instructions are supplied during initialization.
name: session_start

knowledgebase_index.description: The questions the knowledge base answers, one `id | question` per line, for knowledgebase_get.

anyOf.description:
Canonical short-circuit response shape.

`status` is always `"error"` — acts as a discriminator for LLM consumers.
`error` is a machine-readable code (e.g. `session_not_found`).
`reason` is a human-readable explanation of why the call failed.
`detail` carries structured extra context (ids, available values, etc.).

title: Start a Compass session
